Use the public accepted manuscript for the cited Frandsen-Gaussian equations and reconstruct the missing Danish scenario values without optimized-result calibration.
Correct the printed maximization/minimization sign mismatch and add a tight binary implication to the uninstalled-target power-loss row.
Replace unavailable Gurobi by pinned HiGHS and a 33-tangent epigraph approximation with an explicit x-squared error bound.
Implement the full l2-box consensus ADMM lifecycle, adaptive rho, deterministic sphere-centre direction and exact-cardinality final rounding.
Parallelize immutable wake preparation and all 36 scenario subproblems using a persistent all-core C++ team without nested solver threads.
Execute one deterministic native run for each paper case; count scenario subproblem solves separately from complete-layout evaluations.

paper.authors: Yunfei Du and Xinwei Shen and Yangfan Luo and Zehai Huang and Boan Lu
paper.title: A Generic Acceleration Framework for Grid-Based Wind Farm Layout Optimization

paper_source_conflicts: The target prints a maximization Lagrangian with positive squared penalties and then defines the x update by arg-min; the standard convex negative-objective form controls execution.
Printed Equation 1d remains active for x_i=0 and can reject a valid uninstalled cell; a tight M(1-x_i) implication restores the intended binary semantics.
No target code exists to resolve the set-valued sphere projection at its centre; the exact-cardinality warm-start direction controls the deterministic tie.
Pinned HiGHS' active-set QP returns a degeneracy solve error on a verified-feasible generated model; the admitted 33-tangent epigraph realization has an explicit approximation bound.

scope.claim_boundary: equation-level flexible academic reproduction of four problems and complete l2-box ADMM; not author Gurobi code Danish data warm start numerical table identity trajectory or timing replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: exact half-cell cardinality, bounded continuous copies, l2 sphere and tight implication completion of the uninstalled-target wake row

decision_variables.resolution: one binary installation variable and one power variable per grid cell and wind scenario, represented through scenario-local continuous copies plus consensus

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: l2-box continuous equivalence during ADMM and stable top-cardinality binary rounding at output

initialization.resolution: paper warm start and 100-second artifact unavailable; use deterministic exact-cardinality boundary-priority layout and zero duals

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: one deterministic run for each of four native cases; AEP, rounding, residuals, solver work, timing, layout and hash recorded

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize probability-duration-weighted annual generation under precomputed pair power loss; execute as minimization of its negative

paper_native_cases.resolution: 6x6 with 18, 10x10 with 50, 16x16 with 128, and 20x20 with 200 NREL 5 MW turbines

parameters.resolution: 36 ten-degree directions, 5D pitch, initial rho 0.5, zero duals, ten iterations, cited F-G equations and declared adaptive-rho/tolerance rules

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: at most ten ADMM iterations; 36 scenario subproblem solves per iteration; two complete-layout evaluations per run; no EA FES label

update_order.resolution: all scenario x updates then local box/sphere projections then ordered consensus then dual updates; fixed scenario slots and reductions

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Frandsen-Gaussian pair velocity and power loss precomputed for every scenario and grid pair; optimized table values excluded from calibration

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 36 directions at exact 10-degree spacing with normalized smooth Danish-sector weights and disclosed direction-dependent rated-region speeds
